question.text: The total corpus of each scheme of a Category III AIF must be NOT LESS THAN:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that every Category III AIF and each of its schemes must have a minimum corpus of Rs. 20 crore, and that the corpus at first close must not be less than Rs. 20 crore. Each scheme is therefore subject to the same Rs. 20 crore floor. The Trap: Rs. 10 crore, Rs. 50 crore and Rs. 100 crore do not match the prescribed Category III scheme-level minimum corpus. Note: The Rs. 20 crore scheme-level minimum corpus and the first-close requirement are stated in the AIF (Category III) Distributors workbook (Series XIX-B).
